name: Icd10DanishExtensions
title: Danish extensions and deviations to ICD-10
description: Danish SKS diagnosis codes that are not part of plain ICD-10: finer-grained extensions under existing ICD-10 categories and Danish-only blocks. Generated from SKScomplete.txt diffed against http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10 version 2019-covid-expanded by scripts/sks_icd10_diff.py.

property.description: How the code relates to ICD-10: 'extension' adds detail under an existing ICD-10 category; 'deviation' is a Danish-only block absent from ICD-10.
